title: System Engineer – Vehicle Energy Management
jd:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

As a System Engineer – Vehicle Energy Management, you will contribute to the development of innovative energy management concepts for next-generation battery electric (BEV) and fuel cell electric (FCEV) vehicles. Working closely with international engineering teams, you will develop simulation models, evaluate vehicle concepts, and support the optimization of energy efficiency and driving range through advanced system engineering methods.
Your tasks:
► Developing and evaluating innovative vehicle energy management concepts to improve energy efficiency and driving range in zero-emission vehicles
► Developing and maintaining modular 0D/1D vehicle simulation models for powertrain and thermal management systems, including batteries, electric drives, HVAC and cooling circuits
► Ensuring compatibility and integration of vehicle simulation models with component and subsystem models from other Bosch business units
► Continuously improving simulation, evaluation and optimization toolchains to increase efficiency and accuracy
► Supporting technology assessments, optimization studies and customer projects by analyzing and presenting simulation results
► Deriving component requirements and loads from vehicle-level use cases to support product development and project acquisitions
► Collaborating closely with international development teams and contributing to cross-functional engineering activities

► BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related field
► Solid understanding of automotive powertrain and/or thermal management systems for battery electric (BEV) and fuel cell electric (FCEV) vehicles
► Several years of experience with 0D/1D simulation tools and methodologies, preferably in automotive powertrain or thermal management simulation
► Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation environments
► Experience with Design for Reliability (DfR) methodologies, including component load and lifetime analysis
► Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills
► Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in international, cross-functional teams
► Willingness to travel occasionally to Germany
► Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken
What gives you further advantages:
► German language skills
► Experience in vehicle system simulation and optimization
► Knowledge of thermal management technologies and energy efficiency strategies for electric vehicles

Get to know our #LikeABosch benefits.
We would like to help you GROW, so we offer you:
Financial security & recognition: We review and increase your competitive base salary annually, offer performance-, loyalty-, and referral bonus.
 
Trainings and professional development: We believe in a Life-Long Learning approach, so you can take advantage of several technical and soft skill trainings and language courses.
 
Career development: We have a wide range of programs to choose from, even if its leadership, expert or project development you are aiming for. We also offer mentoring and coaching opportunities, we have PhD program and we offer international assignment possibilities.
 
We would like you to ENJOY the benefits of balancing your life and your work, so we pay attention to:
Your work life-balance: You can work from our activity based offices designed for creativity and efficiency or from home while enjoying flexible working hours. We offer childcare possibilities and sabbatical option.
 
Your health and well-being: We provide free professional consultants for any personal, legal, financial or health related issues. You can benefit from our developing onsite medical center and organized regular health checkups.
 
We also offer you several perks and benefits: You can use your annual cafeteria allowance flexibly for family support (e.g. tax-free kindergarten and nursery allowances), health care, mobility (car sharing services) and recreation. You can enjoy our onsite canteen, we support when you work from home and if you live far, we cover your commute costs. We also appreciate your loyalty with jubilee gift and extra jubilee holiday.
You could join an INSPIRING community worth to belong:
We are true to our values: We are committed to sustainability, we value that everyone is different and that diversity makes us truly successful. We also take social responsibility seriously and regularly organize charity actions, blood donations and support worthy causes.
 
Team building activities and community events are also part of our everydays. We like to come together for a good summer party or family day.
Are you ready to work #LikeABosch?
 
Please apply with your English CV!
If you require any further information, please feel free to contact us on the following number: +36 80 18 08 01. Our colleagues can help you with answers during the weekdays between 08:00 a.m. till 11:00 a.m.

title: 高级激光工艺研发工程师_BMG
jd:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

1.Process Innovation and R&D

- Drive Advanced Process Development: Lead the research, design, and implementation of cutting-edge laser-based manufacturing processes—including welding, cutting, drilling, structuring, and patterning—tailored for high-growth industries like NEV, hydrogen/fuel cells, and power electronics.

- Own the Laser Laboratory: Conduct hands-on feasibility studies, rapid process validation, and multi-parameter optimization in our state-of-the-art laboratory, transforming early-stage concepts into robust, repeatable industrial processes.

- Optimize process parameters to achieve extreme high-speed and high-yield targets, directly reducing Cycle Time (CT) for mass production lines.

- Develop specialized, high-yield welding processes for highly reflective and dissimilar materials (e.g., Copper-to-Aluminum busbars) utilizing advanced beam shaping and green/blue wavelength technologies.

2.Machine Integration & Performance

- Accelerate the transition from laboratory proof-of-concept to automated shop-floor execution, supporting rapid prototyping and agile machinery commissioning.

- System-Level Troubleshooting: Analyze, diagnose, and resolve complex technical issues at the intersection of laser optics, process physics, and mechanical automation to guarantee maximum machine efficiency and product quality.

3.Customer Success & Industry Leadership

- Act as a Trusted Technical Consultant: Partner directly with global customers to analyze their unique technical requirements, translating complex engineering challenges into tailored, high-performance laser solutions.

- Shape the Future of Manufacturing: Keep our technology at the forefront of the industry by continuously identifying, testing, and incorporating advancements in ultra-fast/high-power laser sources, advanced beam shaping and optical sensors.

- Deliver High-Standard Technical Documentation: Author comprehensive process guidelines, technical whitepapers, and validation reports to ensure seamless knowledge transfer internally and to our customers.

4.Work #LikeABosch

Thrive in a collaborative, trust-based international culture that actively respects your personal time. We champion a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, hybrid/smart work options (where laboratory duties permit), and a focus on high-efficiency, high-quality output rather than mandatory overtime.

1.Education & Specialized Background

- Academic Foundation: Master's degree or PhD in Laser Technology, Optical Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. (For PhD holders, a strong focus on laser-matter interaction or optical system design is highly preferred; for Master's, solid industrial R&D experience is key).

- Industry-Specific Expertise: Minimum of 3-5 years of proven hands-on experience in laser material processing (specifically welding, cutting, or structuring) with a strong track record in eDrive (hairpin welding), lithium-ion battery manufacturing, or power electronics/semiconductors.

2.Core Technical Mastery

- Advanced Laser Sources & Beam Delivery: Deep technical understanding of high-power fiber lasers, ultrafast lasers (picosecond/femtosecond), and advanced beam shaping technologies (e.g., adjustable ring-mode / AMB lasers, wobble heads, and scanner systems).

- Laser Safety & Optical Design: Solid knowledge of international laser safety standards (e.g., IEC 60825) and hands-on familiarity with optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax, TracePro) is a strong advantage.

- Automation & Diagnostics Integration: Practical experience with CAD/CAM software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) and a strong understanding of how laser systems interface with automated machinery (PLCs, fieldbus systems, robotics). Experience with in-line process monitoring (e.g., OCT, pyrometry, or vision-based weld tracking) is highly valued.

3.Mindset, Leadership & Communication

- Analytical & Hands-on Problem Solver: A methodical, data-driven approach to troubleshooting (utilizing DoE/Design of Experiments, 8D methodologies, or Six Sigma) combined with a willingness to get hands-on in the laser laboratory.

- Global Communication Skills: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required to collaborate within Bosch's global network.

- Collaborative Driver: A strong team-player mindset with the agility to act as the technical bridge between cross-functional R&D, mechanical design, and demanding customer engineering teams.

**Key responsibilities**

As a Sales Support Specialist (f/m/d), you will assume a responsible role in our German sales department for the tendering and marketing of our MNS low\-voltage systems and will be involved in the tendering and marketing to selected potential account customers.

Another key responsibility will be the technical support to our sales team and the development of large\-scale projects (e.g., data centers, chip industry, HVDC grid connections, chemical, oil and gas industries, such as hydrogen production, etc.).

* Successfully completed technical studies or industrial engineering – preferably in electrical engineering or a related technical qualification
* Several years of experience in the sales support of MNS low\-voltage switchgear systems
* In\-depth knowledge of commercial contract issues
* Enthusiasm for technical topics and details combined with a strong customer and goal orientation
* Professional use of digital media (video conferences, virtual meetings, chats, AI, etc.) in customer contact and communication
